# Tauri 2 Linux build prerequisites -- the single source of truth for every
# apt-get step in .github/workflows/.
#
# This list is verbatim https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/ (Debian /
# Ubuntu), checked 2026-09-06. It used to be maintained four times in two
# different spellings: checks.yml installed `libappindicator3-dev` while
# release.yml installed `libayatana-appindicator3-dev`, so the job that gates
# main and the job that ships installers were compiling against different
# system libraries. `libayatana-appindicator3-dev` is the current name --
# libappindicator3 is the retired Canonical library that Ayatana forked and
# replaced, and it is gone from newer Ubuntu images.
#
# `libgtk-3-dev` and `patchelf` are deliberately NOT here. libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
# depends on libgtk-3-dev, and the release `quality` job has compiled this crate
# with exactly this list and no libgtk-3-dev on every release since 26.7.0;
# patchelf is an AppImage bundling tool and the release ubuntu leg bundles an
# AppImage without it.
#
# Jobs that need more than this (the smoke test needs a WebDriver host and a
# virtual display) append their extras on the install line, not here.
#
# Consumed with:  sudo apt-get install -y $(grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' .github/tauri-linux-deps.txt)
# so `#` comments and blank lines are stripped and the rest is word-split.

libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
build-essential
curl
wget
file
libxdo-dev
libssl-dev
libayatana-appindicator3-dev
librsvg2-dev
